1141: ਰੋਗ ਬੰਧ; ਰਹਨੁ ਰਤੀ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Bound by disease, one finds not a moment of rest;
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ; ਰੋਗੁ ਕਤਹਿ. ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
without the True Guru the disease never goes. ॥3॥
One to whom the transcendent Lord shows mercy,
He takes by the arm and pulls out of disease.
His bonds are broken; he has found the company of the holy.
Says Nanak, the Guru has cured the disease. ॥4॥7॥20॥
When He comes to mind, there is supreme bliss.
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜ ॥
When He comes to mind, all pains are shattered.
When He comes to mind, hopes are fulfilled.
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਕਬਹਿ. ਨ ਝੂਰੀ ॥੧॥
When He comes to mind, one never grieves. ॥1॥
The sovereign Lord has revealed Himself within;
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਦੀਓ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the perfect Guru has imbued me with His love. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
When He comes to mind, one is king of all.
When He comes to mind, all affairs are completed.
When He comes to mind, one is dyed deep crimson in His love.
When He comes to mind, one is ever delighted. ॥2॥
When He comes to mind, one is ever wealthy.
When He comes to mind, one is ever free of doubt.
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੇ ॥
When He comes to mind, one enjoys all pleasures.
When He comes to mind, dependence is ended. ॥3॥
ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
When He comes to mind, one finds the home of poise.
When He comes to mind, one is absorbed in the state beyond thought.
When He comes to mind, one ever sings His praises.
Nanak, the mind is pleased with the Lord. ॥4॥8॥21॥
My Father is eternal, ever alive.
My family dwells in the home of the self. ॥1॥
ਹਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭਹਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
I have found peace, and so all are at ease;
ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ; ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੇਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the perfect Guru has united me with my Father. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
My mansions are the highest of all.
My lands are infinite, beyond any reckoning.
My wealth is inexhaustible and permanent. ॥2॥
My glory resounds through all the ages.
My fame spreads through all places and interspaces.
My praises echo in every home.
My devotion is known in all the worlds. ॥3॥
My Father has revealed Himself within me;
Father and son have joined in partnership.
Says Nanak, when the Father is pleased,
Father and son are absorbed in the one love. ॥4॥9॥22॥
O True Guru, Being without enmity, God the Giver,
I am a sinner; You are the Forgiver.
ਜਿਸੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਉ. ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਢੋਈ ॥
The sinner who finds no shelter anywhere,
coming to Your sanctuary, becomes pure. ॥1॥
Pleasing the True Guru, I have found peace.
ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰੂ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Meditating on the Guru, I have obtained all fruits. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I bow to the transcendent Lord, the True Guru.
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
Mind and body are Yours; all the world is Yours.
When the veil is removed, You come into view;
You are the Master, the King of all. ॥2॥
When it pleases Him, dry wood becomes green.
ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ; ਤਾਂ ਥਲ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਰਿਆ ॥
When it pleases Him, a lake appears in the desert.
ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
When it pleases Him, all fruits are obtained;
anxiety departs, clinging to the True Guru's feet. ॥3॥
1142: When He is pleased with the corrupt and virtueless,
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੂਠਾ ॥
mind and body are cooled, and nectar rains down in the mind.
The transcendent Lord, the Guru, has become merciful;
servant Nanak, beholding Him, is enraptured. ॥4॥10॥23॥
My True Guru is dependent on no one.
My True Guru's way is true.
My True Guru is the Giver of all.
My True Guru is the all-pervading Creator. ॥1॥
There is no deity equal to the Guru.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ; ਸੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One with such destiny on the forehead is attached to His service. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
My True Guru kills and revives.
The glory of my True Guru
My True Guru is the strength of the weak.
My True Guru is the support within one's home.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹਉ; ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
I am forever a sacrifice to the True Guru,
who has made the way plain and shown it to me. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਭਉ. ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
One who serves the Guru is not gripped by fear.
ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਦੁਖੁ. ਨ ਸੰਤਾਪੈ ॥
One who serves the Guru is not tormented by pain.
Nanak has studied the Smritis and Vedas:
there is no difference between the transcendent Lord and the Guru. ॥4॥11॥24॥
Taking the Name, the mind is illumined.
ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ; ਪਾਪੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਗਇਆ ॥
Taking the Name, sin leaves the body.
Taking the Name, all holy days are observed.
Taking the Name, one has bathed at the sixty-eight pilgrimage places. ॥1॥
My pilgrimage place is the Lord's Name.
The Guru has taught me the essence of wisdom. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Taking the Name, pain runs far away.
Taking the Name, the greatest fool becomes wise.
Taking the Name, light shines forth.
Taking the Name, entanglements are cut. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ; ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
Taking the Name, Death does not come near.
Taking the Name, one finds peace in the Lord's court.
Taking the Name, God says, "Well done."
The Name is my true wealth. ॥3॥
The Guru has given me this essential teaching:
the Lord's praise, the Name, is the mind's support.
Nanak, people are saved by the Name as atonement;
Bow to Him a hundred thousand times;
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿ ॥
offer this mind as a sacrifice to Him.
there is bliss, and no affliction touches one. ॥1॥
Such is the diamond of the pure Name,
ਜਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ; ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
chanting which all affairs are fulfilled. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਦੁਖ ਡੇਰਾ ਢਹੈ ॥
By His glance the house of pain is torn down;
one holds the cooling, nectar Name in the mind.
ਅਨਿਕ ਭਗਤ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪੂਜਾਰੀ ॥
In an instant He fills the empty to overflowing.
In an instant He turns the dry green.
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ; ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
In an instant He gives a place to the homeless.
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ; ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
In an instant He gives honour to the dishonoured. ॥3॥
1143: he alone meditates on Him who has the perfect True Guru.
The Lord's praise is his support —
says Nanak, the one to whom He Himself is merciful. ॥4॥13॥26॥
I was a discarded bride; He Himself has adorned me.
Granting beauty and love, He has embellished me with the Name.
My pain and all my sorrows are gone;
the Guru has become my mother and father. ॥1॥
O friends and companions, there is bliss in my home;
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਭੇਟੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਕੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in His mercy, my Husband has met me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The burning is quenched; all hopes are fulfilled.
Darkness is dispelled, and there is light.
The unstruck melody is wondrous and amazing;
the Guru is perfect; perfect is His grace. ॥2॥
One to whom the Lord of the world is revealed —
by his sight one is ever enraptured.
ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ; ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
He has all virtues and great treasures,
one to whom the True Guru has given the Name. ॥3॥
One who has met his own Master —
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
his mind and body are cooled, chanting the Lord, Har Har.
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜੋ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ॥
Says Nanak, those servants who are pleasing to God —
rare is the one who obtains their dust. ॥4॥14॥27॥
Thinking up sins, he feels no laziness;
going to a prostitute, he feels no shame at all.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ; ਬਜਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥
but when it is time to remember the Lord, it is as if lightning struck his head. ॥1॥
Attached to Maya, the world is misled.
ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭੁਲਾਵਣਹਾਰੈ; ਰਾਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Deluder Himself has misled it; it is absorbed in useless affairs. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Gazing at Maya's pleasures, his life passes away;
in love with mere shells, he makes a mess of things.
His mind runs after the bonds of blind dealings;
the Creator never comes into his heart. ॥2॥
ਕਰਤ ਕਰਤ ਇਵ ਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Doing and doing like this, he suffers pain;
the affairs of Maya are never completed.
His mind is steeped in lust, anger and greed;
ਤੜਫਿ ਮੂਆ; ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
he writhes and dies like a fish out of water. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਕੇ ਰਾਖੇ; ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ॥
One whose protector the Lord Himself becomes
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਦਾ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
ever chants the Name of the Lord, Har Har.
In the company of the holy he sings the Lord's praises;
Nanak, he has found the perfect True Guru. ॥4॥15॥28॥
One on whom He shows His mercy obtains it,
and enshrines the Lord's Name in the mind.
With the True Word in heart and mind,
the sins of countless lifetimes depart. ॥1॥
The Lord's Name is the soul's support.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ; ਤਾਰਿ ਲਏ ਸਾਗਰ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the Guru's grace, chant it constantly, O brothers; it carries one across the world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
Those for whom the Lord has written this treasure
obtain honour in the Lord's court.
Sing His praises in peace, poise and bliss;
hereafter, even the homeless find a home. ॥2॥
Through age after age, this is the essence:
remembering the Lord is true reflection.
1144: ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਏ; ਸੋ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
One whom He attaches to His hem is attached;
asleep for countless lifetimes, he awakens. ॥3॥
Your devotees are Yours; You Yourself belong to Your devotees.
You Yourself inspire them to chant Your glory.
All beings and creatures are in Your hands;
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੯॥
Nanak's God is ever with them. ॥4॥16॥29॥
The Name of the Inner-knower is within me.
The Name is of use to me.
The Lord's Name pervades every hair of my body.
The perfect True Guru has given me this gift. ॥1॥
The jewel of the Name is in my treasury;
it is inaccessible, priceless, infinite, beyond limit. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Name is my unshakeable Master.
ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਬਨੀ ॥
The glory of the Name shines in all.
The Name is my perfect banker.
The Name is my carefree Lord. ॥2॥
The Name is my food and love.
The Name is my mind's desire.
By the saint's grace I do not forget the Name.
Taking the Name, the unstruck sound resounds fully. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਨਾਮੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
By God's mercy I have obtained the Name, the nine treasures.
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
By the Guru's mercy I have come to love the Name.
They alone are wealthy and supreme,
Nanak, who have the treasure of the Name. ॥4॥17॥30॥
ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ; ਤੂਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
You are my Father; You are my Mother.
You are the Giver of my soul, breath and peace.
ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ; ਹਉ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
You are my Master; I am Your slave.
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
Without You I have no one else. ॥1॥
Be merciful, God, and grant me this gift,
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ; ਕਰਉ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that I may sing Your praises day and night. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I am Your instrument; You are the player.
ਹਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ; ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
I am Your beggar; bless me with Your gift, O Giver.
By Your grace I enjoy all pleasures and delights;
You pervade each and every heart. ॥2॥
By Your mercy, the Name is chanted;
in the company of the holy I sing Your praises.
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ; ਹੋਇ ਦਰਦ ਬਿਨਾਸੁ ॥
By Your kindness, pain is dispelled;
by Your grace, the heart-lotus blossoms. ॥3॥
I am a sacrifice to the divine Guru,
ਸਫਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੇਵ ॥
whose sight is fruitful and whose service is pure.
Be kind to me, my Master, my God,
that Nanak may ever sing Your praises. ॥4॥18॥31॥
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
His court is the highest of all;
bow to Him forever and ever.
ਊਚੇ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ. ਜਾ ਕਾ ਥਾਨ ॥
His place is the highest of the high;
through the Lord's Name millions of sins are erased. ॥1॥
In His sanctuary there is everlasting peace,
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਮੇਲੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
for one whom He mercifully unites with Himself. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਾ ਕੇ ਕਰਤਬ; ਲਖੇ. ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ; ਸਭ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
all hearts rest their faith in Him.
He is revealed in the company of the holy;
His devotees worship Him lovingly night and day. ॥2॥
He gives, and His treasures never run short;
in an instant He establishes and disestablishes.
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ; ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one can erase His command;
He is the True One, above the heads of kings. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਓਟ; ਤਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
He is my anchor and my hope;
1145: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਰਾ; ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
my pain and pleasure are placed before Him alone.
ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ; ਸਭੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪੜਦਾ ॥
He has covered all the faults of His servant;
The weeping woman makes weeping her daily practice,
ਬਲਨ ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ; ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
as dealings and relations with the dead come to mind.
But one who understands and becomes detached
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ; ਫਿਰਿ ਸੋਗੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
grieves no more over birth and death. ॥1॥
All worldly business is the expanse of poisonous Maya;
rare is the one who has made the Name his support. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Maya of three qualities pervades all;
whoever clings to it suffers pain and sorrow.
There is no peace without meditating on the Name;
by great fortune one obtains the treasure of the Name. ॥2॥
One whose mind is charmed by an actor
repents when the costume is removed.
Like taking shelter in the shade of a cloud,
such is the world of attachment and vice. ॥3॥
If one obtains the one thing,
One who by the Guru's grace has obtained the Name —
Nanak, his coming into the world is approved. ॥4॥20॥33॥
Slandering the saints, one wanders in reincarnation.
Slandering the saints, one becomes diseased.
Slandering the saints, one suffers pain.
The slanderer is punished by the Messenger of Death. ॥1॥
Those who quarrel with the saints —
ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
those slanderers find no joy at all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Slandering the devotee, one's body-wall is pierced.
Slandering the devotee, one suffers in hell.
ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਗਲੈ ॥
Slandering the devotee, one rots in the womb.
ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਟਲੈ ॥੨॥
Slandering the devotee, one falls from sovereignty. ॥2॥
The slanderer finds no salvation anywhere;
he eats only what he himself has sown.
He is worse than a thief, a lecher or a gambler;
the slanderer places an unnecessary load upon his head. ॥3॥
The devotees of the transcendent Lord are free of hate;
whoever worships their feet is saved.
The primal Being has deluded the slanderer;
Nanak, past deeds cannot be erased. ॥4॥21॥34॥
The Name is my Vedas and the sound current.
The Name is my worship of the deities.
The Name is my service to the Guru. ॥1॥
The perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me;
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the most sublime task of all is chanting the Lord, Har Har. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Name is my cleansing bath.
The Name is my perfect charity.
Those who take the Name are all sanctified.
Those who chant the Name are my brothers and friends. ॥2॥
The Name is my omen and auspicious time.
The Name is my satisfying feast.
The Name is all my good conduct.
The Name is my pure dealing. ॥3॥
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ. ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
Those in whose minds the one God dwells —
ਸਗਲ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
the Lord, Har Har, is the support of all His servants.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
Nanak, sing the Lord's praises with mind and body —
one to whom He gives the Name in the company of the holy. ॥4॥22॥35॥
1146: To the poor You give wealth;
countless sins depart and the mind becomes pure.
All desires and tasks are fulfilled;
You give Your Name to Your devotee. ॥1॥
Fruitful is service to the sovereign Lord of the world.
ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Master is the Doer and the Cause of all; no one goes away from Him empty-handed. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
God, You cure the disease of the sick;
You erase the sorrow of the suffering, O God;
You seat the homeless in a place of honour;
You attach Your servant to devotion. ॥2॥
God gives honour to the dishonoured;
the utter fool becomes clever and wise;
the fear of all fears runs away;
ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ॥੩॥
the Lord dwells in the mind of His servant. ॥3॥
The transcendent Lord God is the treasure of peace;
the Lord's nectar Name is the essence of wisdom.
In His mercy He attaches one to serving the saints;
Nanak, one is absorbed in the company of the holy. ॥4॥23॥36॥
ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ; ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
In the realm of the saints, the Lord dwells in the mind.
ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ; ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
In the realm of the saints, all sin runs away.
In the realm of the saints, one's way of life is pure.
In the company of the saints, love for the One arises. ॥1॥
That alone is called the realm of the saints
where only the praises of the transcendent Lord are sung. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
In the realm of the saints, birth and death are ended.
ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ; ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੂ. ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
In the realm of the saints, Death says nothing.
In the company of the saints, one's speech becomes pure.
In the realm of the saints, the Name is chanted. ॥2॥
The realm of the saints is an unshakeable seat.
In the realm of the saints, sins are destroyed.
In the realm of the saints, the pure sermon is spoken.
In the company of the saints, the pain of ego runs away. ॥3॥
The realm of the saints is never destroyed.
In the realm of the saints is the Lord, the treasure of virtue.
The realm of the saints is the Master's resting place;
Nanak, God is woven into it through and through. ॥4॥24॥37॥
What disease can touch one whom He Himself protects?
ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ; ਹੋਇ. ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
That servant suffers no pain or sorrow.
One upon whom God shows mercy —
He removes death from above his head. ॥1॥
The Name of the Lord, Har Har, is our ever-present friend.
ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ. ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਨਿਕਟਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One in whose awareness it comes ever has peace; Death does not come near him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਬ ਇਹੁ. ਨ ਸੋ; ਤਬ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
When this being did not exist, who created him then?
From what origin has He revealed what form?
He Himself kills and Himself revives;
ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ; ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
Know that everything is in His hands.
My God is the Master of the masterless.
ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
His Name is the Destroyer of pain;
ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੩॥
sing His praises and you will find peace. ॥3॥
O Master, hear the prayer of Your saints:
soul, breath and wealth are placed before You.
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ; ਸਭ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
This world is Yours; all meditate on You.
1147: In His mercy, Nanak has found peace. ॥4॥25॥38॥
In this Dark Age I live by Your support.
With Your support, all sing Your praises.
With Your support, death cannot touch one.
With Your support, entanglements are destroyed. ॥1॥
In this world and the next, You are my support.
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ; ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one Master pervades all. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
With Your support I celebrate in bliss.
With Your support I chant the Guru's mantra.
With Your support one crosses the terrifying world-ocean;
the perfect Protector is the ocean of peace. ॥2॥
With Your support there is no fear.
That True One is the Inner-knower.
With Your support, Your strength is in the mind;
here and hereafter, You are my court of appeal. ॥3॥
I take Your support; I put my faith in You.
All meditate on God, the treasure of virtue.
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ; ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
Chanting and chanting, Your servants celebrate in bliss.
Nanak, remember the True One, the treasure of virtue. ॥4॥26॥39॥
First, I gave up slandering others;
ਉਤਰਿ ਗਈ; ਸਭ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
all the anxiety of my mind was dispelled.
Greed and attachment were driven out entirely;
seeing God ever present, I became the supreme Vaishnav. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that servant chants the Name of the Lord, Har Har. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I have abandoned the company of my egotistic intellect;
the dye of lust and anger has faded.
I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har Har Hare;
in the company of the holy one is saved. ॥2॥
Enemy and friend have become alike;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Accepting God's will, I have found peace;
the perfect Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me. ॥3॥
One whom the Lord in His mercy protects —
that devotee chants the chant of the Name.
ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥
One whose mind is illumined, who takes understanding from the Guru —
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੪੦॥
says Nanak, his life is fulfilled. ॥4॥27॥40॥
There is no peace in earning great wealth.
There is no peace in watching dances and plays.
There is no peace in conquering many lands.
ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
All peace comes from singing the praises of the Lord, Har Har. ॥1॥
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The company of the holy is found by great fortune; as Guru-facing, chant the Name of the Lord, Har Har. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Mother, father, children and spouse are bonds.
Religious rituals done in ego are bonds.
When the Breaker of bonds dwells in the mind,
ਤਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
then one finds peace, dwelling in the home of the self. ॥2॥
All are beggars; God is the Giver,
the treasure of virtue, infinite and endless.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
One on whom God bestows His grace —
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਿਨੈ ਜਨਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
that servant chants the Name of the Lord, Har Har. ॥3॥
be merciful, O Primal Being, treasure of virtue.
Says Nanak, I have come to Your sanctuary;
as it pleases You, preserve me, O Lord of the world. ॥4॥28॥41॥
Meeting the Guru, I have abandoned love of duality;
1148: as Guru-facing, I chant the Lord's Name.
Anxiety is forgotten; I am in love with the Name.
Asleep for countless lifetimes, I have awakened. ॥1॥
In His mercy, He has attached me to His service;
ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in the company of the holy, all peace is obtained. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Guru's Word has eradicated disease and evil;
the medicine of the Name is cherished within the mind.
Meeting the Guru, the mind is in bliss;
the Name of the Lord is all treasure. ॥2॥
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ. ਮਿਟੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
The fear of Death, of birth and death, is erased;
in the company of the holy, the inverted heart-lotus blossoms.
Singing His praises, one finds an unshakeable rest,
and all affairs are perfectly resolved. ॥3॥
This human body, so hard to obtain, is approved;
ਸਫਲ ਹੋਈ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
it becomes fruitful, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har Har.
Says Nanak, God has shown me mercy;
with every breath and morsel I chant the Lord, Har Hari. ॥4॥29॥42॥
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
His Name is the highest of all;
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
sing His praises forever and ever.
and all peace comes to dwell in the mind. ॥1॥
O mind, remember that True One;
ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ. ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
here and hereafter you will be saved. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
gives sustenance to all beings and creatures.
He forgives millions of sins in an instant;
through loving devotion He saves forever. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ; ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
and unwavering understanding, are obtained from the perfect Guru.
One whom the Protector mercifully protects —
His attention is focused on the transcendent Lord;
the Lord, free of desire, is perfectly pervading.
Erasing doubt and fear, one meets the Lord of the world —
Nanak, the one to whom the Guru has become merciful. ॥4॥30॥43॥
Remembering Him, the mind is illumined,
sorrows are erased, and one dwells in peace and poise.
They alone receive it, to whom God gives it;
they are blessed with service to the perfect Guru. ॥1॥
All peace is in Your Name, O God;
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
around the clock, O my mind, sing it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One obtains the fruits one desires
by enshrining the Lord's Name in the mind.
Comings and goings cease, meditating on the Lord,
ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lovingly attuned to God through devotion. ॥2॥
Lust, anger and ego are destroyed;
love and attachment to Maya are broken.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ; ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
One rests on God's support day and night,
one whom the transcendent Lord blesses with this gift. ॥3॥
O Master, Doer and Cause of all,
be merciful and attach me to Your service;
ਲਾਜ ਮਰੈ; ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
One who does not take the Name dies of shame.
Without the Name, how can one sleep in peace?
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਚਾਹੈ ॥
Abandoning remembrance of the Lord, one longs for the supreme state —
1149: but without the root, how can there be branches? ॥1॥
O my mind, meditate on the Guru, the Lord of the universe.
ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ; ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ. ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He washes off the filth of countless lifetimes, cuts the bonds and unites one with the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Bathing at a pilgrimage place, how can a stone become pure?
The filth of ego clings to the mind.
Millions of rituals are the root of bondage;
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਪੂਲੁ ॥੨॥
without meditating on the Lord, they are a useless bundle. ॥2॥
Without eating, hunger is not satisfied;
when the disease is cured, then the pain goes.
He is engrossed in lust, anger, greed and attachment;
ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ; ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੩॥
he does not meditate on God, the God who created him. ॥3॥
ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ; ਧੰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Blessed, blessed are the holy, and blessed is the Lord's Name;
around the clock, sing the kirtan of His praises.
Blessed is devotion to the Lord, and blessed is the Creator;
Nanak seeks the sanctuary of God, the infinite Being. ॥4॥32॥45॥
When the Guru was pleased, my fears departed;
I hold the Name of the immaculate Lord in my mind.
He is merciful to the meek, ever compassionate;
I have found abundant peace, poise and bliss.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ. ਮਿਟੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਭਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the company of the holy, fear and doubt are dispelled; my tongue chants the nectar of the Lord, Har Har. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I have fallen in love with the lotus feet;
in an instant the terrible demon is destroyed.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
Around the clock, chant the chant of the Lord, Har Har;
the Guru, the Lord of the universe, is Himself the Protector. ॥2॥
He watches over every breath of His devotees.
Tell me, what can mere humans do?
ਜਮ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ; ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੩॥
He gives His hand and saves them even from Death. ॥3॥
Pure is the glory and pure the way of life
of one in whose mind and awareness the transcendent Lord has come.
In His mercy the Guru has given the gift;
Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Name. ॥4॥33॥46॥
My Guru is the all-powerful Cause of causes,
the Giver of soul, breath and peace, ever near.
He is the Destroyer of fear, the eternal King;
beholding His sight, all pain departs. ॥1॥
Wherever I look, I see Your sanctuary;
ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the feet of the True Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
My affairs are fulfilled, meeting the divine Guru;
He is the Giver of all fruits; His service is pure.
He takes His servants by the hand,
and enshrines the Lord's Name in their hearts. ॥2॥
There is everlasting bliss and no sorrow at all;
no pain, suffering or disease afflicts one.
Everything is Yours; You are the Creator,
O transcendent Lord, Guru, inaccessible and infinite. ॥3॥
His glory is pure, and His Word is wondrous;
the perfect transcendent Lord is pleasing to my mind.
He pervades water, land and sky;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੭॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਰਣੇ ॥
My mind and body are imbued with love for the Lord's feet;
1150: Around the clock I sing of God;
the True Guru has given me the perfect mantra. ॥1॥
Very fortunate is one who loves the Name;
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in his company the world is carried across. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He alone is wise who remembers the One.
He alone is wealthy who has discerning intellect.
He alone is of noble lineage who remembers the Master.
He alone is honourable who understands his own self. ॥2॥
By the Guru's grace one attains the supreme state,
meditating day and night on the virtues of the Lord of the world.
Bonds are broken and hopes fulfilled;
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ; ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
the Lord's feet dwell in the heart. ॥3॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
Says Nanak, one whose destiny is perfect —
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
that servant comes to God's sanctuary.
He himself is pure and purifies all;
his tongue tastes the Lord's elixir. ॥4॥35॥48॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ; ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
Taking the Name, no obstacle blocks the way.
Hearing the Name, Death runs far away.
Taking the Name, all pains are destroyed.
Chanting the Name, one dwells at the Lord's feet. ॥1॥
ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਭਗਤਿ; ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
Devotion is free of obstacles; meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har Har.
ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
With delight upon delight, sing the Lord's praises. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਖੁ. ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
Remembering the Lord, no evil eye can touch one.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਦੈਤ ਦੇਉ. ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥
Remembering the Lord, no demon or spirit can affect one.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ. ਨ ਬਧੈ ॥
Remembering the Lord, attachment and pride do not bind.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਰੁਧੈ ॥੨॥
Remembering the Lord, one is not confined to the womb. ॥2॥
Every moment is the time to remember the Lord;
among many, only one remembers the Lord.
High caste or low caste, whoever chants —
ਜੋ ਜਾਪੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
whoever meditates on Him is saved. ॥3॥
The Lord's Name is chanted in the company of the holy;
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ; ਪੂਰਨ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
there the love of the Lord's Name is perfect.
O God, show mercy to Nanak,
that with every breath he may remember the Lord. ॥4॥36॥49॥
He Himself is the Shastras, He Himself the Vedas;
He Himself knows the secrets of each and every heart.
ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ; ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ॥
He is the embodiment of light; all things belong to Him;
He is the Cause of causes, perfectly all-powerful. ॥1॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ; ਗਹਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
Grasp the protection of God, O my mind.
ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ; ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਖੁ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
As Guru-facing, worship His lotus feet; enemies and pain will not come near you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
He Himself is the forest and the vegetation, the essence of the three worlds;
the universe is strung on His thread.
He Himself unites soul and matter;
He Himself is detached, and He Himself the enjoyer. ॥2॥
ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ; ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
Wherever I look, there He is;
without Him there is no other.
Through love of the Name the ocean is crossed;
Nanak sings His praises in the company of the holy. ॥3॥
ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
Liberation, enjoyment and the way of life are in His control;
ਊਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ; ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
One with whom He is pleased in His mercy —
servant Nanak, such servants are blessed. ॥4॥37॥50॥
The minds of the devotees of the Lord of the universe are in bliss;
they have become steady, and all their anxiety is gone.
